I re-decided without defaulting to close-on-adverse. Taking +0.5R as a conservative average winner, hold beats close unless a stop-out is more than about 88% likely before a bounce, and I put it near 65-70% given the broken structure. Modest confidence: the stop is already the venue protection, the 84.94 flush low sits just below it, and widening is not supported. Tighten has no valid level (atr:1.0/1.5/2.0 invalid_level) and is advice-only anyway.
